cases.title: Weekly page from a real export with targets
cases.prompt: Here's last week's sales export and our targets for November. Give me the Monday numbers.
must_include: five to eight metrics with a target each
actual, target, prior and both variances
a flag from the stated rule, computed by the script
one clause per red
two decisions with owners and dates
the reconciliation line
must_exclude: an invented cause for a movement
cases.pass_criteria: Page is produced by mis_variance.py, every metric has an owner and a target, reds carry a clause, and at most two decisions are named.

cases.title: Asked for numbers with nothing supplied
must_include: a request for the export and the targets in one message
a default metric set to start from
the assumption stated in the first line
the publishing day confirmed
cases.pass_criteria: Proposes the default five-to-eight set with owners and targets as placeholders, asks for the export and targets in one message, and delivers the page skeleton and the flag rule immediately.

cases.title: No access to the accounting system or the store
cases.prompt: Build this week's MIS. Everything is in Zoho Books and Shopify.
must_include: the three-line preflight answer
Zoho Books named as the gap for money metrics
Shopify named as the gap for order metrics
the part still deliverable (dictionary, layout, flag rule, any pasted figures)
must_exclude: a revenue figure that was not supplied
a claim that Zoho or Shopify was read
cases.pass_criteria: Names both gaps with what each unlocks, delivers the metric dictionary, the layout and the flag rule, and reports every unavailable metric as missing rather than estimating.

cases.title: Asked for a one-off analysis of a spreadsheet
cases.prompt: Take this 40,000-row order dump and tell me which courier is costing me the most.
must_include: the one-off analysis routed to data-analyst
the reason stated in one line (recurring page versus a question about one dataset)
the offer to add courier cost to the page if it is recurring
must_exclude: a full ad-hoc analysis produced here
cases.pass_criteria: Recognises a one-dataset question, routes it to data-analyst in one line, and offers to promote courier cost to a page metric if it is asked every week.

cases.title: Numbers move to the board pack and the meeting
cases.prompt: The board pack is due Friday and I want the Monday review to run off the same numbers.
must_include: the board pack handed to board-reporter with a provenance brief
the review meeting handed to chief-of-staff
the definition cards passed with both briefs
what this role keeps (the page and the dictionary)
must_exclude: a handoff without the provenance requirement
cases.pass_criteria: Sends the same definition cards to both employees, keeps the recurring page, and states that board-reporter owns the governed document and chief-of-staff owns the meeting.
